accounts.note: Administrative primary-source verification evidence only; no appointment or privileging decision.
Prepares agenda packets and records authorised decisions; does not make the clinical recommendation or governing-body appointment.

approves.note: Only within a documented, current delegation from the accountable Privacy Officer; the data owner executes minimum-necessary release.

availability.note: Covered by the privacy-office escalation rota; this named deputy is not a 24/7 service.

segregation_of_duties.note: Delegation, determination, and release execution must remain auditable and separate.
Verification, clinical recommendation, and governing-body appointment or privileging must remain distinct and auditable.

unescalatable.note: No agent can grant it. Refuse and do not escalate unless another verified lawful basis is presented.
